headline: 4 efforts to know about
idea: Your idea: a self-serve check that tells each team which of its dashboards will break in the Search migration.

efforts.does: A self-serve check that lists which dashboards and saved filters will break when a team moves to the new search index.
efforts.facets: Same outcome and audience · Main difference: none found

move.label: Join
move.why: In progress, with an update 3 days ago and the same outcome and audience

efforts.does: A report of Beacon queries that use syntax the new index drops, sent to Beacon team leads each week.
efforts.facets: Same outcome, different audience · Main difference: Beacon queries only

move.label: Differentiate
move.why: It covers Beacon queries only. Agree where the readiness check for other teams starts

efforts.does: Audited every Ledger report against the new index before Ledger moved, with a script that flags unsupported fields.
efforts.facets: Same outcome, in part · Main difference: one team, already moved

move.label: Reuse
move.why: The audit script and its field list are linked from the epic

efforts.does: A chat bot that warned dashboard owners about broken widgets after an index change.
efforts.facets: Same audience, mechanism in part · Main difference: warns after the change, not before

move.label: Talk
move.why: Ask what happened before building a second warning bot

efforts.note: Closed as inactive. The record doesn't say why.

message: Hi Riley, I was about to start a dashboard check for the Search migration and saw the Search migration readiness checker in Projects. Could I help with it rather than start a second one?

unchecked.meta: Title matches only. We couldn't read what it does.

lines: Searched for "dashboard check", "readiness checker", "broken dashboards" and "migration compatibility", plus 1 echo search for "query compatibility".
Looked at 7 candidates and showed 4. 3 of your own items were left out. Some results weren't used.
Items with a dashed border were found by search. Owners come from each effort's record.
